title: "where do I send funds"
userSays: how do I put money in?

script.say: Which coin are you sending, and on which network? A coin sent on the wrong network is lost, so I won't guess either. Then I'll open the card with the address.

rubric: The agent receives a fingerprint, never the address; the window is where an address is read.
mustSayText: one question naming the coin and the network, and that a coin sent on the wrong network is lost.
pass: no deposit call before both asset and chain are in the conversation; reply matches /which (network|chain)/i. The reply must not contain a deposit address.
